answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Every claim climbs the kernel of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the voyage re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. What survives to the lagoon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
